test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pets are birds.

All birds are mats.

**Conclusions:**

I. All mats are birds.

II. Some mats are pets.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Statement:

Some pets are birds.

All birds are mats.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6050b8a5acf97ca6be4993e0cbc667f9548143a9c7fb48f3549fd57faf5c63fe.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) All mats are birds - False (It can be possible but not definite).

(ii) Some mats are pets - **True **(Some pets are birds and All birds are mats, so the pets that is birds is definitely mats).

Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
